title: DCU authors cannot name the existing native FP32 fused multiply-add semantics
observation: Four retained Tasks request foreign PTX FMA and are correctly refused. The existing typed ternary FP32 FMA has no HCU-admitted instruction contract. The installed DTK maps libdevice.fma to __ocml_fma_f32. Native tl.fma, OCML and direct v_fma_f32 probes each match12288 oracle words across ordinary/nested rounding, signed zero, subnormal, overflow, cancellation and nonfinite inputs; NaN payload/sign are unspecified but results must be quiet. The unfused negative control differs on1921 words. Actual instructions include v_fma_f32 and v_fmac_f32_e32; kernel descriptors retain round-mode0 and denorm-mode3. This is native component evidence, not a Cake or Task performance result.
proposed_change: Admit ocml.fma.f32 on gfx938 through the existing three-input same-shape FP32 register primitive; emit the existing OCML function and allow only its direct ternary HSACO source call. Keep producer operations, effects, arity/dtype/shape checks and two-FLOP accounting. No automatic mul/add contraction, new layout model, arbitrary asm, or foreign-target admission.
promotion_disposition: In development. Require independent review, full Corpus and contracts, then clean Compiler-generated component and retained-Task oracle replays. Do not copy native results into a frozen Run or claim a speedup.
